reference.profile_law: Prescribed synthetic energies, rebound to each current context; not inferred from device bias.

interpretation: Historical local synthetic integration controls. Per-link context payloads deduplicated by owned context hash. Source-associated profiles are not proof of physical self-consistency.
provider_boundary: Ordinary trusted, side-effect-free Python callback; no executable provider is serialized. Its identifier is caller-declared provenance, not authentication.
current_model: Existing compact directional-rate/supply heuristic retained; not a new microscopic current model.
